plugin.name: Keycheck
plugin.author: Eric
plugin.purpose: All-around key manager: keyring window, walk-to key rooms, keyrecord, krk, warnkey

trigger.name: KeyAdded_Older
trigger.match: ^.+ will expire before the one already on your keyring\.$

muclient.script:
require "gmcphelper"
-- Keep in step with version= above; shown on load so a reload is visible. local VERSION = "3.8"
-- Standard colour theme local CLR_TAG = "#875FFF" -- x099 brackets local CLR_NAME = "#00D7FF" -- x045 plugin name local CLR_MSG = "#FFFFFF" -- message text local CLR_HI = "#00FF87" -- x048 good news, values, links local CLR_WARN = "#FFAF00" -- errors/usage (semantic, not part of the theme) local CLR_MISS = "#FF0000" -- missing keys: bright red local CLR_MELT = "#FF00D7" -- x200: a key melting within MELT_HOURS
local MELT_HOURS = 20
-- "[Keycheck] message" echo. `colour` defaults to the plain message colour. local function KeyNote(text, colour) ColourTell(CLR_TAG, "black", "[") ColourTell(CLR_NAME, "black", "Keycheck") ColourTell(CLR_TAG, "black", "] ") ColourNote(colour or CLR_MSG, "black", text) end
local manual_check = false
-- Set to true to print each captured key name (to confirm name parsing). local debug = false
-- Split a comma-separated line preserving empty fields (an empty flags field -- like "id,,name,..." must not collapse, or every later field shifts left). local function SplitFields(s) local t = {} local start = 1 while true do local i = string.find(s, ",", start, true) if not i then t[#t + 1] = string.sub(s, start) break end t[#t + 1] = string.sub(s, start, i - 1) start = i + 1 end return t end
-- Strip Aardwolf colour codes (@x123 extended, @w/@Y/etc standard, @@ literal). local function StripColours(s) s = s:gsub("@x%d+", "") s = s:gsub("@%a", "") s = s:gsub("@@", "@") return s end
-- Normalise a raw name field to a plain lowercase key for comparison. local function CleanName(s) s = StripColours(s or "") s = s:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") return s:lower() end
-- ---------------- the key list ---------------- -- The key list lives in the data file, not here. DEFAULT_KEYS is only what -- a brand-new data file starts with: one example key per tab, so each tab -- has something to show. Each key: -- name the keyring name (case-insensitive match) -- from who / what it comes from (shown in the window) -- area area label; room = mapper room for [go] (nil = not known) -- rough true = room is only the area entrance (shown with a *) -- cmd what to run when you get it (default "krk") local DEFAULT_KEYS = { ["201"] = { { name = "the tower key", from = "Philip the rat", area = "Fury", room = 45668, rough = true }, }, ["Sub"] = { { name = "a thin dragonscale key", from = "Bagger, the entrance guard", area = "Ascent", room = 43150 }, }, }
local TABS = { "201", "Sub" } local keys = { ["201"] = {}, ["Sub"] = {} } local cur_tab = "201"
-- "201" / "sub" (any case) -> tab name, else nil. local function TabFromWord(w) w = (w or ""):lower() for _, tab in ipairs(TABS) do if tab:lower() == w then return tab end end return nil end
-- Level from GMCP; nil if not known yet. local function CurrentLevel() local ok, v = pcall(gmcp, "char.status.level") return ok and tonumber(v) or nil end
-- The tab keycheck and keyrecord use: Sub below 201, otherwise 201. local function TabForLevel() local lv = CurrentLevel() if lv and lv < 201 then return "Sub" end return "201" end
-- ---------------- data file ---------------- -- Our own file, not SetVariable: a reinstall or a hang can lose SetVariable -- data that was never flushed to the state file. local DATA_FILE = GetInfo(66) .. "Keycheck_data.lua" -- warnkey: keys with warn = true are watched. Under MELT_HOURS left, -- keycheck shows a [Gather Keys] warning, and the WarnKeyTick timer repeats -- that warning (no window) every WARN_EVERY_SECS until the key is replaced. -- warn_melt_at = when the soonest watched key melts (os.time()), from the -- last keyring read; nil = unknown or nothing watched. local warn_melt_at = nil local WARN_EVERY_SECS = 2 * 3600 local last_warn = 0 -- os.time() of the last keycheck / reminder
-- A clean copy of one key entry (drops anything unexpected). local function CopyKey(k) if type(k) ~= "table" or type(k.name) ~= "string" or k.name == "" then return nil end return { name = k.name, from = tostring(k.from or "?"), area = tostring(k.area or ""), room = tonumber(k.room), rough = (k.rough == true) or nil, cmd = (type(k.cmd) == "string" and k.cmd ~= "") and k.cmd or nil, warn = (k.warn == true) or nil } end
-- disk_text = the file's contents as this plugin last read or wrote them. -- If the file on disk is different, it was changed outside the plugin (by -- hand, or by another tool): Sync() reads that version in before a command -- changes anything, and Save() never writes over it. local disk_text = nil
local function ReadDataFile() local f = io.open(DATA_FILE, "rb") if not f then return nil end local s = f:read("*a") f:close() return s end
local function SaveData() local out = { "-- Keycheck data: your key list and settings. Safe to edit any time:\n", "-- the plugin reads your changes in before it next saves.\n", "return {\n keys = {\n" } for _, tab in ipairs(TABS) do out[#out + 1] = string.format(" [%q] = {\n", tab) for _, k in ipairs(keys[tab]) do local extra = "" if k.rough then extra = extra .. ", rough = true" end if k.cmd then extra = extra .. string.format(", cmd = %q", k.cmd) end if k.warn then extra = extra .. ", warn = true" end out[#out + 1] = string.format(" { name = %q, from = %q, area = %q, room = %s%s },\n", k.name, k.from or "?", k.area or "", k.room and tostring(k.room) or "nil", extra) end out[#out + 1] = " },\n" end out[#out + 1] = string.format(" },\n warn = { melt_at = %s },\n}\n", warn_melt_at and string.format("%d", warn_melt_at) or "nil") local text = table.concat(out) local tmp = DATA_FILE .. ".tmp" local f = io.open(tmp, "wb") if not f then KeyNote("Could not write " .. DATA_FILE, CLR_WARN) return end f:write(text) f:close() os.remove(DATA_FILE) -- os.rename will not replace a file on Windows if not os.rename(tmp, DATA_FILE) then KeyNote("Could not save " .. DATA_FILE, CLR_WARN) return end disk_text = text end
-- Data-file text -> fresh key tables and melt time, or nil if it will not -- load. Nothing in use is touched until it has loaded cleanly. local function ParseData(text) local fn = loadstring(text or "") if not fn then return nil end setfenv(fn, {}) local ok, t = pcall(fn) if not ok or type(t) ~= "table" or type(t.keys) ~= "table" then return nil end local nk = { ["201"] = {}, ["Sub"] = {} } for _, tab in ipairs(TABS) do for _, k in ipairs(type(t.keys[tab]) == "table" and t.keys[tab] or {}) do local c = CopyKey(k) if c then nk[tab][#nk[tab] + 1] = c end end end local melt = nil if type(t.warn) == "table" then melt = tonumber(t.warn.melt_at) -- v3.3 and older: warnkey was one on/off switch for Crynn's Key. Carry -- an "on" over as a watch on Crynn's Key when nothing is watched yet. if t.warn.on == true then local any, crynn = false, nil for _, tab in ipairs(TABS) do for _, k in ipairs(nk[tab]) do if k.warn then any = true end if not crynn and k.name:lower() == "crynn's key" then crynn = k end end end if not any and crynn then crynn.warn = true end end end return nk, melt end
-- Load the data file. No file (first run) -> start from DEFAULT_KEYS and -- write it. A file that will not load is left alone, never overwritten, -- and the keys already in use stay as they are. Returns true if loaded. local data_ok = true local function LoadData() local text = ReadDataFile() if not text then keys = { ["201"] = {}, ["Sub"] = {} } for _, tab in ipairs(TABS) do for _, k in ipairs(DEFAULT_KEYS[tab]) do keys[tab][#keys[tab] + 1] = CopyKey(k) end end warn_melt_at, data_ok = nil, true SaveData() return true end local nk, melt = ParseData(text) if not nk then data_ok, disk_text = false, text KeyNote("Could not read " .. DATA_FILE .. "; nothing will be saved until it is fixed.", CLR_WARN) return false end keys, warn_melt_at, data_ok, disk_text = nk, melt, true, text return true end
-- Read the file in if it was changed outside the plugin. Every command that -- changes or uses the list calls this first. True = it was changed. local function Sync() local text = ReadDataFile() if text == nil or text == disk_text then return false end if LoadData() then KeyNote("Picked up changes made to Keycheck_data.lua outside the plugin.") end return true end
-- Every change goes through here. A broken file, or one changed outside the -- plugin since it was last read, is never written over. local function Save() if not data_ok then return end local text = ReadDataFile() if text ~= nil and disk_text ~= nil and text ~= disk_text then LoadData() KeyNote("Keycheck_data.lua was changed outside the plugin, so that version was loaded " .. "and your last change was not saved. Do it again if you still want it.", CLR_WARN) return end SaveData() end
LoadData()
-- The room to walk to for a key, and the area label (with * when rough). local function RoomFor(k) return k.room, (k.rough and k.room) and (k.area .. "*") or k.area end
-- One number per key whatever your level: 201-tab keys are 1-100, Sub-tab -- keys 101-200 (SUB_BASE + index). Used in the window, keyroom and warnkey. local SUB_BASE = 100 local function KeyNum(tab, i) return tab == "Sub" and (SUB_BASE + i) or i end local function FromNum(n) n = tonumber(n) if not n or n < 1 then return nil end if n > SUB_BASE then return "Sub", n - SUB_BASE end return "201", n end
-- "kearvek" -> "Kearvek" local function NiceArea(zone) if not zone or zone == "" then return "" end return zone:sub(1, 1):upper() .. zone:sub(2) end
-- ---------------- keyring window ---------------- -- Same chrome as MarketWatch's pop-up: themed_miniwindows' ThemedTextWindow -- with the package theme, our palette on the text only. Link text is Lua run -- in this plugin (text_rect.lua browseUrl -> loadstring), so the KW_* -- functions are global. local gHaveWin = pcall(require, "themed_miniwindows")
local WIN_ID = "Keycheck_keyring" local WIN_FONT = "Consolas" local WIN_FONT_SIZE = 13
local gWin = nil local last_have = nil -- name -> list of { id, secs }, from the latest keycheck
local gColCache = {} local function col(hex) if not gColCache[hex] then gColCache[hex] = ColourNameToRGB(hex) end return gColCache[hex] end
-- One line of style runs plus its hyperlinks. Link positions count the -- VISIBLE text only, which is what TextRect indexes against. local function winLine(segs) local styles, links, pos = {}, {}, 1 for _, s in ipairs(segs) do if s.text ~= "" then styles[#styles + 1] = { text = s.text, textcolour = col(s.colour or CLR_MSG) } if s.code then links[#links + 1] = { start = pos, stop = pos + #s.text - 1, text = s.code, label = s.tip } end pos = pos + #s.text end end return styles, links end
-- Never reuse an object the library no longer knows about (a zombie window -- has live hotspots and no window_map entry). local function ensureWin() if not gHaveWin then return false end if gWin and not (ThemedWindowClass and ThemedWindowClass.window_map and ThemedWindowClass.window_map[WIN_ID]) then gWin = nil pcall(WindowDelete, WIN_ID) end if not gWin then local ok, w = pcall(ThemedTextWindow, WIN_ID, 0, 0, -- first-run position; after that it stays where dragged 700, 600, -- default size; fit_contents sizes it to the text "Keyring", "center", -- title alignment true, -- is_temporary: gives the title-bar close button false, -- resizeable true, -- text_scrollable: the list can be taller than the cap false, -- text_selectable false, -- text_copyable false, -- url_hyperlinks: ours are explicit false, -- autowrap: rows are laid out in columns WIN_FONT, WIN_FONT_SIZE, -- title font WIN_FONT, WIN_FONT_SIZE, -- text font 200, -- max lines nil, -- padding true, -- defer showing until drawn false, nil, "Close") if not ok or not w then gHaveWin = false return false end gWin = w -- Bold body text. A style's bold flag only shows when the world's -- show_bold option is on, so instead redefine the TextRect's normal -- font as bold. TextRect:loadFont creates it once at init and never -- again for the same name/size, so this sticks, and widths and link -- hotspots are measured with the same (bold) font. pcall(function() local tr = gWin.textrect WindowFont(tr.window, tr.font, WIN_FONT, WIN_FONT_SIZE, true, false, false, false, 0) tr.font_height = WindowFontInfo(tr.window, tr.font, 1) tr:setLineSpacing(tr.line_spacing) end) local prior = gWin.do_on_delete gWin.do_on_delete = function(self) if prior then prior(self) end if gWin == self then gWin = nil end end end return true end
-- "3d 4h" / "5h 12m" / "" for no timer. local function TimeLeft(secs) if not secs or secs < 0 then return "" end local d = math.floor(secs / 86400) local h = math.floor((secs % 86400) / 3600) local m = math.floor((secs % 3600) / 60) if d > 0 then return string.format("%dd %dh", d, h) end return string.format("%dh %dm", h, m) end
local function pad(s, n) if #s >= n then return s:sub(1, n) end return s .. string.rep(" ", n - #s) end
-- Match the captured keyring against one tab. Returns rows + shortfall. -- status: "ok", "missing", or "unsure" (a doubled name where you hold some -- but not all, so which one is gone cannot be told). local function BuildRows(tab, have) local list = keys[tab] local want = {} for _, k in ipairs(list) do local n = k.name:lower() want[n] = (want[n] or 0) + 1 end local seen, rows, short, counted = {}, {}, 0, {} for i, k in ipairs(list) do local n = k.name:lower() seen[n] = (seen[n] or 0) + 1 local got = have[n] and #have[n] or 0 local status = "ok" if got == 0 then status = "missing" elseif got < want[n] then status = "unsure" end if not counted[n] then counted[n] = true if got < want[n] then short = short + (want[n] - got) end end local uid, area = RoomFor(k) rows[#rows + 1] = { tab = tab, idx = i, key = k, status = status, uid = uid, area = area or "", ring = have[n] and have[n][seen[n]] or nil } end return rows, short end
-- [delete] needs a second click: the first arms it for that key and the -- row shows [sure?] until it is clicked or 5 seconds pass. local pending_delete = nil -- { key = <entry>, gen = <n> } local delete_gen = 0
-- One window row. The [go] link and the key name both walk to the room. -- [remove] (only for a key on the keyring) takes it off the keyring; -- [delete] takes the key out of Keycheck for good. A key on the ring that -- melts within MELT_HOURS has its name and time in x200. local function RowSegs(r) local ref = string.format("%q,%d", r.tab, r.idx) local arming = pending_delete and pending_delete.key == r.key local secs = r.ring and r.ring.secs local melting = r.status == "ok" and secs and secs >= 0 and secs < MELT_HOURS * 3600 local go_code = r.uid and ("KW_Goto(" .. ref .. ")") or nil local tip = r.uid and ("Walk to room " .. r.uid .. " for " .. r.key.name) or nil local name_colour = (r.status ~= "ok") and CLR_MISS or (melting and CLR_MELT or CLR_MSG) local mark = "" if r.status == "unsure" then mark = " (1 of 2?)" end local name_txt = r.key.name .. mark return { { text = string.format(" %3d ", KeyNum(r.tab, r.idx)), colour = r.key.warn and CLR_NAME or CLR_TAG }, { text = r.uid and "[go]" or " -- ", colour = r.uid and CLR_HI or CLR_TAG, code = go_code, tip = tip }, { text = " " }, { text = name_txt, colour = name_colour, code = go_code, tip = tip }, { text = string.rep(" ", math.max(1, 34 - #name_txt)) }, { text = pad(r.key.from or "?", 26), colour = CLR_MSG }, { text = " " }, { text = pad(r.area ~= "" and r.area or "?", 11), colour = CLR_NAME }, { text = " " }, { text = pad(TimeLeft(secs), 8), colour = melting and CLR_MELT or CLR_HI }, { text = " " }, (r.ring and r.ring.id) and { text = "[remove]", colour = CLR_NAME, code = "KW_Unring(" .. ref .. ")", tip = "Take " .. r.key.name .. " off your keyring" } or { text = " " }, { text = " " }, arming and { text = "[sure?]", colour = CLR_MISS, code = "KW_Delete(" .. ref .. ")", tip = "Click again to delete " .. r.key.name .. " from Keycheck for good" } or { text = "[delete]", colour = CLR_WARN, code = "KW_Delete(" .. ref .. ")", tip = "Delete " .. r.key.name .. " from Keycheck for good (asks once more)" }, } end
-- The tab buttons: the open tab in green, the other one clickable. local function TabSegs() local segs = { { text = " " } } for _, tab in ipairs(TABS) do if tab == cur_tab then segs[#segs + 1] = { text = "[ " .. tab .. " ]", colour = CLR_HI } else segs[#segs + 1] = { text = "[ " .. tab .. " ]", colour = CLR_TAG, code = string.format("KW_Tab(%q)", tab), tip = "Show the " .. tab .. " keys" } end segs[#segs + 1] = { text = " " } end return segs end
-- Output-window version for when themed_miniwindows will not load. local function ShowKeyNotes(rows) for _, r in ipairs(rows) do if r.status ~= "ok" then ColourTell(CLR_TAG, "black", string.format(" %3d ", KeyNum(r.tab, r.idx))) if r.uid then Hyperlink("mapper goto " .. r.uid, r.key.name, "Walk to room " .. r.uid, CLR_MISS, "black", false) else ColourTell(CLR_MISS, "black", r.key.name) end ColourNote(CLR_MSG, "black", " " .. (r.key.from or "?") .. " ", CLR_NAME, "black", r.area) end end end
-- Draw cur_tab from the last keyring capture. keep_scroll: a redraw of a -- window that is already up (after a click, keyroom, keyrecord) stays where -- you were reading instead of jumping back to the top. local function ShowKeyWindow(keep_scroll) if not last_have then return end local rows, short = BuildRows(cur_tab, last_have) local keep = nil if keep_scroll and gWin and gWin.textrect then keep = tonumber(gWin.textrect.display_start_line) end if not ensureWin() then ShowKeyNotes(rows) return end gWin:clear(false)
local s, l = winLine(TabSegs()) gWin:add_text(s, false, l) gWin:add_text(winLine { { text = " " } }, false, {})
if #rows == 0 then gWin:add_text(winLine { { text = " No keys on the " .. cur_tab .. " tab yet.", colour = CLR_MSG } }, false, {}) gWin:add_text(winLine { { text = " Stand where a key comes from, type ", colour = CLR_TAG }, { text = "keyrecord", colour = CLR_HI }, { text = ", then get the key.", colour = CLR_TAG }, }, false, {}) else s, l = winLine { { text = " Keyring " .. cur_tab .. ": ", colour = CLR_MSG }, { text = tostring(#rows - short), colour = CLR_HI }, { text = " of ", colour = CLR_MSG }, { text = tostring(#rows), colour = CLR_HI }, { text = " keys", colour = CLR_MSG }, { text = short > 0 and (" " .. short .. " missing") or " all present", colour = short > 0 and CLR_MISS or CLR_HI }, } gWin:add_text(s, false, l)
local function section(title, want_ok) local any = false for _, r in ipairs(rows) do if (r.status == "ok") == want_ok then if not any then gWin:add_text(winLine { { text = " " } }, false, {}) gWin:add_text(winLine { { text = " " .. title, colour = CLR_NAME } }, false, {}) any = true end s, l = winLine(RowSegs(r)) gWin:add_text(s, false, l) end end end section("Missing", false) section("On your keyring", true) end
gWin:add_text(winLine { { text = " " } }, false, {}) gWin:add_text(winLine { { text = " Click ", colour = CLR_TAG }, { text = "[go]", colour = CLR_HI }, { text = " to walk there. ", colour = CLR_TAG }, { text = "keyroom <#>", colour = CLR_HI }, { text = " sets a key's room to where you stand.", colour = CLR_TAG }, }, false, {}) gWin:add_text(winLine { { text = " ", colour = CLR_TAG }, { text = "[remove]", colour = CLR_NAME }, { text = " takes a key off your keyring. ", colour = CLR_TAG }, { text = "[delete]", colour = CLR_WARN }, { text = " drops it from Keycheck for good (click twice).", colour = CLR_TAG }, }, false, {}) gWin:add_text(winLine { { text = " ", colour = CLR_TAG }, { text = "keyrecord", colour = CLR_HI }, { text = " in the room a key comes from, then get it, adds it here.", colour = CLR_TAG }, }, false, {}) gWin:add_text(winLine { { text = " ", colour = CLR_TAG }, { text = "pink", colour = CLR_MELT }, { text = " = melts within " .. MELT_HOURS .. " hours. * = only the area entrance; ", colour = CLR_TAG }, { text = "keyroom <#>", colour = CLR_HI }, { text = " it.", colour = CLR_TAG }, }, false, {})
-- 400px tall at most; the rest scrolls (wheel or scrollbar). pcall(function() gWin:fit_contents(2000, 400) end) -- Scroll AFTER fitting: add_text follows the newest line like a console, -- and rows above the viewport get no hotspot when drawn. setScroll clamps -- an out-of-range line, so a kept position past the end is safe. pcall(function() gWin:set_scroll(keep or 1) end) gWin:draw() gWin:show() -- The layout's invisible drag bar (z 154) eats clicks on windows under it. pcall(WindowSetZOrder, WIN_ID, 99999) pcall(Repaint) end
-- Redraw the window if it is up, keeping the scroll. -- Safe from inside a link click: no WindowDelete happens here. local function RedrawIfOpen() if gWin and last_have then ShowKeyWindow(true) end end
-- Tab button click. A different tab starts at the top. function KW_Tab(tab) tab = TabFromWord(tab) if not tab or tab == cur_tab then return end cur_tab = tab ShowKeyWindow(false) end
-- [remove] click: take this key off the keyring by its object id (from the -- last keyring data), then drop it from the window's copy so the row turns -- red without another keyring query. function KW_Unring(tab, i) tab, i = TabFromWord(tab), tonumber(i) if not (tab and i and last_have) then return end for _, r in ipairs((BuildRows(tab, last_have))) do if r.idx == i then if not (r.ring and r.ring.id) then return end local id = r.ring.id SendNoEcho("keyring get " .. id) local list = last_have[r.key.name:lower()] or {} for j = #list, 1, -1 do if list[j].id == id then table.remove(list, j) end end KeyNote("Took " .. r.key.name .. " off your keyring.") RedrawIfOpen() return end end end
-- [delete] click: first click arms [sure?] for 5 seconds, second deletes -- the key from the list and the data file. No undo. function KW_Delete(tab, i) -- edited outside: the numbers on screen may be stale, so just redraw if Sync() then RedrawIfOpen() return end tab, i = TabFromWord(tab), tonumber(i) local k = tab and i and keys[tab][i] if not k then return end if not (pending_delete and pending_delete.key == k) then delete_gen = delete_gen + 1 pending_delete = { key = k, gen = delete_gen } DoAfterSpecial(5, "KW_DeleteExpire(" .. delete_gen .. ")", sendto.script) RedrawIfOpen() return end pending_delete = nil table.remove(keys[tab], i) Save() KeyNote("Deleted " .. k.name .. " (" .. (k.from or "?") .. ") from Keycheck's " .. tab .. " list.") RedrawIfOpen() end
function KW_DeleteExpire(gen) if pending_delete and pending_delete.gen == tonumber(gen) then pending_delete = nil RedrawIfOpen() end end
-- [go] link / key name click: walk to that key's room. Window stays open. function KW_Goto(tab, i) if Sync() then RedrawIfOpen() return end tab, i = TabFromWord(tab), tonumber(i) local k = tab and i and keys[tab][i] if not k then return end local uid = RoomFor(k) if not uid then return end KeyNote("Walking to " .. k.name .. " (" .. (k.from or "?") .. ", room " .. uid .. ")") Execute("mapper goto " .. uid) end
-- Every watched key, in list order: { tab, i, k }. local function Watched() local out = {} for _, tab in ipairs(TABS) do for i, k in ipairs(keys[tab]) do if k.warn then out[#out + 1] = { tab = tab, i = i, k = k } end end end return out end
-- Check the watched keys against a keyring capture: sets warn_melt_at to -- the soonest melt and saves if it moved. Only a key that is on the keyring -- with a running timer counts ("live"): an expired or not-yet-gathered key -- (someone on a long redo) never warns until it is back on the ring. Returns { k, secs, live, due } per watched key. local function UpdateMelt(have) local now, soonest, status = os.time(), nil, {} for _, e in ipairs(Watched()) do local r = have[e.k.name:lower()] and have[e.k.name:lower()][1] local live = r ~= nil and r.secs ~= nil and r.secs > 0 local secs = live and r.secs or 0 status[#status + 1] = { k = e.k, secs = secs, live = live, due = live and secs < MELT_HOURS * 3600 } if live and (not soonest or secs < soonest) then soonest = secs end end local melt_at = soonest and (now + soonest) or nil if melt_at ~= warn_melt_at then warn_melt_at = melt_at Save() end return status end
local function GatherTag() ColourTell(CLR_TAG, "black", "[") ColourTell(CLR_NAME, "black", "Gather Keys") ColourTell(CLR_TAG, "black", "] ") end
-- warnkey [<#>|off]: <#> (the key's number in keycheck / keyroom) starts or -- stops watching that key; off stops watching every key; bare lists them. function WarnKeyCmd(name, line, wildcards) Sync() local arg = (wildcards[1] or ""):lower() if arg == "" then local w = Watched() GatherTag() if #w == 0 then ColourTell(CLR_TAG, "black", "No key watched. ") ColourTell(CLR_NAME, "black", "warnkey <#>") ColourNote(CLR_TAG, "black", " watches one (numbers from keycheck or keyroom).") else ColourNote(CLR_TAG, "black", "Watching (warns under " .. MELT_HOURS .. "h left):") for _, e in ipairs(w) do ColourTell(CLR_NAME, "black", string.format(" %3d ", KeyNum(e.tab, e.i))) ColourNote(CLR_TAG, "black", e.k.name) end end return end local k if arg == "off" then local w = Watched() for _, e in ipairs(w) do e.k.warn = nil end GatherTag() ColourNote(CLR_TAG, "black", #w > 0 and ("Stopped watching " .. #w .. The numbers are in keycheck and keyroom (Sub keys start at 101).", CLR_WARN) return end k.warn = (not k.warn) or nil GatherTag() if k.warn then ColourTell(CLR_TAG, "black", "Watching ") ColourTell(CLR_NAME, "black", k.name) ColourTell(CLR_TAG, "black", ": under ") ColourTell(CLR_NAME, "black", MELT_HOURS .. "h") ColourNote(CLR_TAG, "black", " left you get a [Gather Keys] warning, every 2 hours until it is replaced.") else ColourTell(CLR_TAG, "black", "Stopped watching ") ColourNote(CLR_NAME, "black", k.name .. ".") end end -- refresh the melt time from the last keycheck, if there was one, then -- always save: UpdateMelt only saves when the melt time moved, which -- left a watch on a key that is off the keyring unsaved before v3.8 if last_have then UpdateMelt(last_have) elseif #Watched() == 0 then warn_melt_at = nil end Save() if not last_have then if k and k.warn then GatherTag() ColourTell(CLR_TAG, "black", "Type ") ColourTell(CLR_NAME, "black", "keycheck") ColourNote(CLR_TAG, "black", " once so it knows when it melts.") end end RedrawIfOpen() end

-- Current room from GMCP: uid, zone, name. nil if it cannot be read. local function HereRoom() local info = gmcp("room.info") local uid = type(info) == "table" and tonumber(info.num) if not uid or uid < 0 then return nil end return uid, tostring(info.zone or ""), tostring(info.name or "") end
-- ---------------- SnD / mapper lookups (read only) ---------------- -- Search and Destroy's SnDdb.db keeps every room it has seen each mob in -- (mobs: mob, roomid, zone) and each area's first room (area: key, -- startRoom). The mapper's database maps a room to its area (rooms: uid, -- area). Both are optional: with neither installed these return nil and -- keyrecord just records the exact room, as before. local SND_DB = GetInfo(66) .. "SnDdb.db" local MAPPER_ID = "b6eae87ccedd84f510b74714" -- Aardwolf_GMCP_Mapper
local function MapperDb() -- same rule as the mapper: its db_name variable, else the world name local name = GetPluginVariable(MAPPER_ID, "db_name") if not name or name == "" then name = (WorldName():gsub("[^%w%s()_-]", ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")) end return GetInfo(66) .. name .. ".db" end
local function SqlStr(s) return "'" .. tostring(s):gsub("'", "''") .. "'" end
-- First row of a query, or nil. Never creates a database file: sqlite3.open -- would make an empty one, so the file must already exist. local function QueryRow(path, sql) if not sqlite3 then return nil end local probe = io.open(path, "rb") if not probe then return nil end probe:close() local row = nil pcall(function() local db = sqlite3.open(path) if not db then return end for r in db:nrows(sql) do if not row then row = r end end pcall(function() db:close_vm() end) db:close() end) return row end
-- How many different rooms SnD has seen a mob in, in one area. local function WanderRooms(mob, zone) if not mob or mob == "" or not zone or zone == "" then return nil end local r = QueryRow(SND_DB, "SELECT count(DISTINCT roomid) AS n FROM mobs WHERE mob = " .. SqlStr(mob) .. " AND zone = " .. SqlStr(zone)) return r and tonumber(r.n) or nil end
-- An area's first room, from SnD's area list. local function AreaStart(zone) if not zone or zone == "" then return nil end local r = QueryRow(SND_DB, "SELECT startRoom AS s FROM area WHERE key = " .. SqlStr(zone)) return r and tonumber(r.s) or nil end
-- The area key a mapper room belongs to. local function RoomZone(uid) if not uid then return nil end local r = QueryRow(MapperDb(), "SELECT area AS a FROM rooms WHERE uid = " .. SqlStr(uid)) return r and r.a and r.a ~= "" and r.a or nil end
-- keyroom [<#> [here|<roomid>|clear]] (numbers: 1-100 = 201 tab, 101-200 = Sub) function KeyRoomCmd(name, line, wildcards) Sync() local arg = (wildcards[1] or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
if arg == "" then KeyNote("Key rooms (keyroom <#> to set one to where you stand):") for _, tab in ipairs(TABS) do ColourNote(CLR_NAME, "black", " " .. tab) if #keys[tab] == 0 then ColourNote(CLR_TAG, "black", " none yet; keyrecord adds them.") end for i, k in ipairs(keys[tab]) do local uid, area = RoomFor(k) ColourTell(k.warn and CLR_NAME or CLR_TAG, "black", string.format(" %3d ", KeyNum(tab, i))) ColourTell(CLR_MSG, "black", pad(k.name, 32)) if uid then ColourTell(CLR_NAME, "black", pad(area or "", 11) .. " ") Hyperlink("mapper goto " .. uid, tostring(uid), "Walk to room " .. uid, CLR_HI, "black", false) else ColourTell(CLR_WARN, "black", "no room yet") end Note("") end end return end
local n, rest = arg:match("^(%d+)%s*(.*)$") local tab, i = FromNum(n) local k = tab and keys[tab][i] if not k then KeyNote("No key number '" .. arg .. "'. Type keyroom to see the numbers.", CLR_WARN) return end rest = rest:lower()
if rest == "clear" then k.room, k.rough = nil, nil Save() KeyNote(k.name .. " has no room now.") elseif rest == "area" then -- the area's first room: area from the key's room (mapper), else from -- where you stand; first room from SnD's area list local zone = RoomZone(k.room) if not zone then local _, here_zone = HereRoom() zone = (here_zone and here_zone ~= "") and here_zone or nil end local start = AreaStart(zone) if not start then KeyNote("Can't find that area's first room (it comes from Search and Destroy's area list). " .. "Stand at the entrance and type keyroom " .. n .. ".", CLR_WARN) return end k.room, k.rough = start, true if (k.area or "") == "" then k.area = NiceArea(zone) end Save() KeyNote(k.name .. " now walks to the first room of " .. zone .. " (" .. start .. ").", CLR_HI) elseif rest:match("^%d+$") then k.room, k.rough = tonumber(rest), nil Save() KeyNote(k.name .. " now walks to room " .. rest .. ".", CLR_HI) elseif rest == "" or rest == "here" then local uid, zone, rname = HereRoom() if not uid then KeyNote("Can't read your room number from GMCP here. Try keyroom " .. n .. " <roomid>.", CLR_WARN) return end k.room, k.rough = uid, nil -- keep an area label the user already has (short names like "BL") if zone ~= "" and (k.area or "") == "" then k.area = NiceArea(zone) end Save() KeyNote(k.name .. " now walks to room " .. uid .. " (" .. rname .. ").", CLR_HI) else KeyNote("Usage: keyroom <#>, keyroom <#> <roomid>, keyroom <#> area, keyroom <#> clear", CLR_WARN) return end
RedrawIfOpen() end
-- ---------------- captures ---------------- -- keyring data and invdata both come wrapped in tags; KeyringLine (match *) -- is only enabled between a start tag and its end tag and appends to -- whichever buffer the start tag picked. local keyring_lines = {} local inv_lines = {} local collect = nil -- buffer KeyringLine appends to, or nil local capture_mode = nil -- "check" (keycheck) or "record"
-- invdata requests answer in the order sent; each {/invdata} pops the -- oldest purpose, so overlapping requests never take each other's reply. local inv_queue = {} local record_inv = {} -- inventory lines for keyrecord's check
local function RequestInv(purpose) inv_queue[#inv_queue + 1] = purpose EnableTrigger("InvStart", true) EnableTrigger("InvEnd", true) SendNoEcho("invdata") end
local function StartKeyringCapture(mode) keyring_lines = {} collect = nil capture_mode = mode EnableTrigger("KeyringStart", true) EnableTrigger("KeyringEnd", true) -- KeyringLine stays disabled until a start tag fires EnableTrigger("KeyringLine", false) SendNoEcho("keyring data") end
-- ---------------- pickups and keyrecord ---------------- -- keyrecord notes the room you stand in, then watches get / receive / steal / -- gives-you / buy lines. A moment after the last one it asks for invdata and -- keyring data. Anything it saw you get that is already on the keyring is a -- key; anything still loose in inventory is offered to the keyring with -- "keyring put <id>", and the keyring is read again: whatever it took is a -- key or pass. The game decides, so passes and odd item types work. local REC_SETTLE = 1.5 -- seconds after the last loot line before checking local REC_RECHECK = 1.0 -- seconds after the keyring put before re-reading local REC_TIMEOUT = 600 -- keyrecord gives up after 10 minutes
local rec = nil -- { tab, uid, area, rname, loot = {}, settle, gen, offered } local rec_gen = 0
local function StopRecording() rec = nil rec_gen = rec_gen + 1 end
-- The pickup command for a key name on either tab ("krk" unless the entry -- has its own cmd), or nil when the name is not on the list. local function PickupCmd(n) for _, tab in ipairs(TABS) do for _, k in ipairs(keys[tab]) do if k.name:lower() == n then return k.cmd or "krk" end end end return nil end
-- keyrecord [201|sub|stop] function KeyRecordCmd(name, line, wildcards) Sync() local arg = (wildcards[1] or ""):lower() if arg == "stop" or arg == "off" then if rec then StopRecording() KeyNote("keyrecord stopped.") else KeyNote("keyrecord was not running.") end return end local tab = TabFromWord(arg) if arg ~= "" and not tab then KeyNote("Usage: keyrecord, keyrecord sub, keyrecord 201, keyrecord stop", CLR_WARN) return end tab = tab or TabForLevel() local uid, zone, rname = HereRoom() if not uid then KeyNote("Can't read your room number from GMCP here, so keyrecord can't start.", CLR_WARN) return end StopRecording() rec_gen = rec_gen + 1 rec = { tab = tab, uid = uid, zone = zone, area = NiceArea(zone), rname = rname, loot = {}, settle = 0, gen = rec_gen } DoAfterSpecial(REC_TIMEOUT, "KR_Timeout(" .. rec_gen .. ")", sendto.script) ColourTell(CLR_TAG, "black", "[") ColourTell(CLR_NAME, "black", "Keycheck") ColourTell(CLR_TAG, "black", "] ") ColourTell(CLR_MSG, "black", "Recording keys for the ") ColourTell(CLR_HI, "black", tab) ColourTell(CLR_MSG, "black", " tab in " .. rname .. " (" .. uid .. "). Get the key now; ") ColourTell(CLR_HI, "black", "keyrecord stop") ColourNote(CLR_MSG, "black", " cancels.") end
function KR_Timeout(gen) if rec and rec.gen == tonumber(gen) then StopRecording() KeyNote("keyrecord gave up after 10 minutes with no key.", CLR_WARN) end end
-- Loot lines (KeyLoot group, always on). Two jobs: run the pickup command -- for any key on the list, and feed keyrecord while it runs. -- KR_Get You get <item> from <container / the corpse of mob> -- KR_GetFloor You get <item>. (no "from") -- KR_Receive You receive <item> from <mob> -- KR_ReceiveBare You receive <item>. (no "from": the Dark Key) -- KR_Steal You deftly steal <item> from <mob> -- KR_Gives <mob> gives you <item> -- KR_GivesTo <mob> gives <item> to you -- KR_Buy You buy <item> from <shopkeeper> for <price>. function KR_Loot(name, line, wildcards) local item, from if name == "KR_Gives" or name == "KR_GivesTo" then from, item = wildcards[1], wildcards[2] else item, from = wildcards[1], wildcards[2] end item = item or "" local count = tonumber(item:match("^%(%s*(%d+)%)")) or 1 item = item:gsub("^%(%s*%d+%)%s*", ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") if item == "" then return end -- the "from"-less triggers also match the full lines; leave those to the others if (name == "KR_GetFloor" or name == "KR_ReceiveBare") and item:find(" from ", 1, true) then return end if item:lower():find("gold coin", 1, true) then return end -- taking a key off the keyring ([remove] / keyring get) is not a pickup if (from or ""):lower():find("keyring", 1, true) then return end local cmd = PickupCmd(CleanName(item)) if cmd then for _ = 1, math.min(count, 5) do Execute(cmd) end end if not rec then return end from = (from or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") from = from:gsub("^the .-corpse of ", ""):gsub("^corpse of ", "") if name == "KR_Steal" then from = from .. " (steal)" end if from == "" then from = rec.rname end table.insert(rec.loot, { item = item, from = from }) rec.offered = nil -- new loot: start the check over rec.settle = rec.settle + 1 DoAfterSpecial(REC_SETTLE, "KR_Verify(" .. rec.gen .. "," .. rec.settle .. ")", sendto.script) end
-- The loot has settled: look at inventory and the keyring. function KR_Verify(gen, settle) if not rec or rec.gen ~= tonumber(gen) or rec.settle ~= tonumber(settle) then return end record_inv = {} RequestInv("record") StartKeyringCapture("record") end
-- After offering loose items to the keyring: read the keyring again. function KR_Recheck(gen) if not rec or rec.gen ~= tonumber(gen) or not rec.offered then return end StartKeyringCapture("record") end
-- Pickup command for a newly recorded name: krk ("keyring replace key") -- only finds items called "key", so anything else (a pass, an orb) gets -- "keyring replace <last word>". Editable in the data file. local function DefaultCmd(name) local lname = name:lower() if lname:find("%f[%a]key%f[%A]") or lname:match("key$") then return nil end local last = lname:match("(%a+)%s*$") return last and ("keyring replace " .. last) or nil end
-- Add or update one looted key on rec.tab. A name already on the tab gets -- its room set (preferring the entry with the same source); a new name is -- added at the end of that tab. local function RecordKey(item, from) local list = keys[rec.tab] local want = CleanName(item) local hit = nil for i, k in ipairs(list) do if k.name:lower() == want then if not hit then hit = i end if CleanName(k.from) == CleanName(from) then hit = i break end end end local k, idx, new if hit then k, idx, new = list[hit], hit, false k.room, k.rough = rec.uid, nil -- keep an area label the user already has (short names like "BL") if rec.area ~= "" and (k.area or "") == "" then k.area = rec.area end else k = { name = item, from = from, area = rec.area, room = rec.uid, cmd = DefaultCmd(item) } list[#list + 1] = k idx, new = #list, true end -- A mob SnD has seen in 2+ rooms of this area wanders: point [go] at the -- area's first room instead of the room it happened to die in. local seen = WanderRooms((from:gsub(" %(steal%)$", "")), rec.zone) local wander = nil if seen and seen >= 2 then local start = AreaStart(rec.zone) if start then k.room, k.rough = start, true wander = seen end end return idx, new, wander end
local function FinishRecord() local on_ring = {} for _, entry in ipairs(keyring_lines) do local f = SplitFields(entry) if f[3] then on_ring[CleanName(f[3])] = true end end
-- First look: offer every loose looted item to the keyring by object id, -- then come back (KR_Recheck) and read the keyring again. if not rec.offered then local inv_id = {} for _, entry in ipairs(record_inv) do local f = SplitFields(entry) local n, id = f[3] and CleanName(f[3]), tonumber(f[1]) if n and id and not inv_id[n] then inv_id[n] = id end end local offered, any = {}, false for _, L in ipairs(rec.loot) do local n = CleanName(L.item) if not on_ring[n] and inv_id[n] and not offered[n] then offered[n] = true any = true SendNoEcho("keyring put " .. inv_id[n]) end end if debug then KeyNote("keyrecord: " .. #record_inv .. " inventory lines, " .. #keyring_lines .. " keyring lines, offered " .. tostring(any)) end if any then rec.offered = offered DoAfterSpecial(REC_RECHECK, "KR_Recheck(" .. rec.gen .. ")", sendto.script) return end end
-- Decide: on the keyring now = a key (an offered item it refused is not). local done, got, notkey = {}, {}, {} for _, L in ipairs(rec.loot) do local n = CleanName(L.item) if not done[n] then done[n] = true if on_ring[n] then local idx, new, wander = RecordKey(L.item, L.from) got[#got + 1] = { item = L.item, from = L.from, idx = idx, new = new, wander = wander } else notkey[#notkey + 1] = L.item end end end rec.offered = nil
if #got == 0 then rec.loot = {} KeyNote("Not a key: " .. table.concat(notkey, ", ") .. ". Still watching; get the key, or keyrecord stop.", CLR_WARN) return end
Save() local tab, uid, rname = rec.tab, rec.uid, rec.rname StopRecording() for _, g in ipairs(got) do ColourTell(CLR_TAG, "black", "[") ColourTell(CLR_NAME, "black", "Keycheck") ColourTell(CLR_TAG, "black", "] ") ColourTell(CLR_MSG, "black", "Recorded ") ColourTell(CLR_HI, "black", g.item) ColourTell(CLR_MSG, "black", " (" .. g.from .. ") at " .. rname .. " (" .. uid .. ") into keycheck, ") ColourTell(CLR_HI, "black", tab) ColourNote(CLR_MSG, "black", " tab #" .. KeyNum(tab, g.idx) .. (g.new and ", new key." or ", room updated.")) if g.wander then ColourTell(CLR_TAG, "black", "[") ColourTell(CLR_NAME, "black", "Keycheck") ColourTell(CLR_TAG, "black", "] ") ColourTell(CLR_MSG, "black", (g.from:gsub(" %(steal%)$", "")) .. " moves around (Search and Destroy has seen it in " .. g.wander .. " rooms), so ") ColourTell(CLR_HI, "black", "[go]") ColourTell(CLR_MSG, "black", " takes you to the area's first room. ") ColourTell(CLR_HI, "black", "keyroom " .. KeyNum(tab, g.idx)) ColourNote(CLR_MSG, "black", " sets an exact room instead.") end end RedrawIfOpen() end
-- Manual keycheck alias: open the tab for your level. function ManualKeyCheck(name, line, wildcards) Sync() cur_tab = TabForLevel() manual_check = true last_warn = os.time() -- keycheck shows the warning itself StartKeyringCapture("check") end
-- WarnKeyTick timer (every 30s): while a watched key is inside MELT_HOURS -- (as of the last keyring read), read the keyring quietly every 2 hours -- and print just the [Gather Keys] lines (capture mode "warn", no window). -- Each read refreshes the melt time, so a replaced key ends the reminders. function WarnKeyTick() if not warn_melt_at or capture_mode then return end local now = os.time() if warn_melt_at - now >= MELT_HOURS * 3600 then return end if now - last_warn < WARN_EVERY_SECS then return end last_warn = now StartKeyringCapture("warn") end
-- One [Gather Keys] line for a watched key under MELT_HOURS (x099 / x045). local function GatherLine(e) local s = e.secs local left = string.format("%dd %dh %dm", math.floor(s / 86400), math.floor((s % 86400) / 3600), math.floor((s % 3600) / 60)) GatherTag() ColourTell(CLR_NAME, "black", e.k.name) ColourTell(CLR_TAG, "black", " has ") ColourTell(CLR_NAME, "black", left) ColourTell(CLR_TAG, "black", " left, under ") ColourTell(CLR_NAME, "black", MELT_HOURS .. "h") ColourNote(CLR_TAG, "black", ". Time to gather the keys again.") end
-- {invdata} seen: collect inventory lines function InvStart(name, line, wildcards) inv_lines = {} collect = inv_lines EnableTrigger("KeyringLine", true) end
-- krk alias: "keyring replace key" swaps the key in your inventory onto the -- keyring (or puts it there if you had none). Sent without echo; the reply -- is swapped for "Key Added" by KeyAdded below. function KrkCmd(name, line, wildcards) SendNoEcho("keyring replace key") end
-- "You replace <key> on your keyring." / "You put <key> on your keyring." -- are gagged (omit_from_output) and shown as a green "Key Added". -- "<key> will expire before the one already on your keyring." is gagged -- with no note: the newer copy stays on the ring, nothing was added. function KeyAdded(name, line, wildcards) ColourNote(CLR_HI, "black", "Key Added") end
-- {/invdata} seen: stop collecting and hand the lines to whoever asked function InvEnd(name, line, wildcards) collect = nil EnableTrigger("KeyringLine", false) local purpose = table.remove(inv_queue, 1) if #inv_queue == 0 then EnableTrigger("InvStart", false) EnableTrigger("InvEnd", false) end if purpose == "record" then record_inv = inv_lines end end
-- {keyring} seen: collect keyring lines function KeyringStart(name, line, wildcards) keyring_lines = {} collect = keyring_lines EnableTrigger("KeyringLine", true) end
-- Each data line between tags function KeyringLine(name, line, wildcards) if collect then table.insert(collect, line) end end
-- {/keyring} seen: stop collecting, then record or report function KeyringEnd(name, line, wildcards) collect = nil EnableTrigger("KeyringLine", false) EnableTrigger("KeyringStart", false) EnableTrigger("KeyringEnd", false) Sync() -- keycheck, keyrecord and the warnkey reminder all save after this
if capture_mode == "record" then capture_mode = nil if rec then FinishRecord() end return end local mode = capture_mode capture_mode = nil if mode ~= "warn" then if not manual_check then return end manual_check = false end
-- Keyring data format: itemid,flags,name,level,type,f6,f7,timer_seconds -- Field 1 = object id ([remove] uses it), field 3 = the key name, -- field 8 = seconds until the key melts (-1 = no timer). local have = {} for _, entry in ipairs(keyring_lines) do local fields = SplitFields(entry) local nm = fields[3] if nm then nm = CleanName(nm) have[nm] = have[nm] or {} table.insert(have[nm], { id = tonumber(fields[1]), secs = tonumber(fields[8]) or -1 }) end if debug then KeyNote("name='" .. tostring(fields[3]) .. "' -> '" .. CleanName(fields[3] or "") .. "'") end end -- the 2-hour warnkey reminder: [Gather Keys] lines only, no window if mode == "warn" then for _, e in ipairs(UpdateMelt(have)) do if e.due then GatherLine(e) end end return end last_have = have
local rows, short = BuildRows(cur_tab, have) if #rows == 0 then KeyNote("The " .. cur_tab .. " tab has no keys yet; keyrecord adds them.") elseif short == 0 then KeyNote(string.format("All %d %s keys present on your keyring.", #rows, cur_tab), CLR_HI) else KeyNote(string.format("MISSING %d %s key(s) -- see the Keyring window.", short, cur_tab), CLR_MISS) end ShowKeyWindow(false)
-- warnkey: a watched key under MELT_HOURS gets a [Gather Keys] line in -- x099 / x045; a live one above that shows its time left; an expired or -- missing one says nothing (it shows red in the window anyway). for _, e in ipairs(UpdateMelt(have)) do local s = e.secs local left = string.format("%dd %dh %dm", math.floor(s / 86400), math.floor((s % 86400) / 3600), math.floor((s % 3600) / 60)) if not e.live then -- expired / not gathered yet: stays quiet elseif e.due then GatherLine(e) else ColourTell(CLR_TAG, "black", "[") ColourTell(CLR_NAME, "black", "Keycheck") ColourTell(CLR_TAG, "black", "] ") ColourTell(CLR_MSG, "black", e.k.name .. ": ") ColourTell(CLR_HI, "black", left) ColourNote(CLR_MSG, "black", " remaining.") end end end
